messages.text: Friday, September 25 · Canton, Michigan
Full Moon Rises Over Overcast Skies for Friday Evening
An overcast but mild Friday evening is set for a full moon. Locally, the Ann Arbor District Library is celebrating Dolly Parton, while nearby Detroit offers a free film screening.
Expect an overcast day with a high near 68°F and a low around 45°F; there is a 1% chance of precipitation.
Sunrise is at 7:25 AM, sunset at 7:26 PM, and the moon is full and 97.6% illuminated.
Evening Gatherings and Celebrations

For a free community event, the Windsor International Film Festival is showing "Best in Show" at Campus Martius Park in Detroit at 7:00 PM. In Ann Arbor, the District Library hosts "Dolly Day" with crafts and music videos starting at 5:30 PM.
The next notable calendar item is the Autumn equilux, occurring tomorrow at 12:27 AM.
Ann Arbor Plans Spending for Downtown Lot Sale Funds
Ann Arbor City Council has approved a spending plan for the expected $14.2 million to $17.4 million from the sale of the Kline's lot. The funds will be allocated to 12 different projects.
Tomorrow Offers Cultural and Musical Events

Tomorrow, Ypsilanti kicks off "The Big Read" at the Michigan Library Plaza at 11:00 AM with performances and speakers. The Ark in Ann Arbor features multiple musical acts throughout the evening, including Devon Gilfillian at 8:00 PM.
Satellites Navigate Without GPS, Roman Telescope Prepares for Launch

NASA's Starling satellites have demonstrated GPS-free autonomous navigation using onboard cameras and object catalogs. The Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope has cleared its flight-readiness review and is preparing for launch.
The next Starship launch is estimated to be no earlier than September 18, 2026, according to independent listings.
Find a quiet moment to appreciate the turning of the season.
Saturday, September 26 · Canton, Michigan
Full moon rises over an overcast autumn Saturday

An overcast but mild Saturday is here, with a full moon gracing the evening sky. Locally, Ypsilanti is considering new development standards, while science offers a new method for autonomous satellite navigation.
Today will be overcast with a high near 73°F and a low around 48°F, with no chance of precipitation.
Sunrise is at 7:26 AM and sunset is at 7:24 PM, under a full moon that is 99.7% illuminated.
Saturday's Nearby Happenings
In Ypsilanti, the Spinning Dot Theatre presents Mariposa/Butterfly at YDL-Whittaker at 2 PM. For music lovers, The Ark in Ann Arbor hosts The Bros. Landreth at 7:30 PM and Devon Gilfillian at 8 PM.
Next Wednesday, September 30, marks both My Birthday and Patrick's Birthday.
Ann Arbor's plan for downtown property sale funds

Ann Arbor City Council has outlined a spending plan for the expected $14.2 million to $17.4 million from the sale of the city-owned Kline’s lot. The funds will be distributed across 12 distinct projects, including affordable housing and sustainable energy.
Tomorrow and the days ahead

Tomorrow in Ann Arbor, catch the Jazz Fest at The Ravens Club starting at 2 PM, or enjoy a Women in Jazz Showcase at Blue LLaMA Jazz Club at 6 PM. In Ypsilanti, Growing Hope hosts Chefs in the Garden at 5 PM.
Satellites navigate without GPS

NASA's Starling satellites have successfully demonstrated GPS-free autonomous navigation using onboard cameras and a catalog of space objects. Additionally, the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope has completed its flight-readiness review.
The next Starship launch is estimated to be no earlier than September 18, 2026.
May your Saturday hold a quiet discovery.
